draft_body:
Subject: CSOAI crosswalk — signed measurement of agentic payments

Hi Stripe Research,

We have published a permissionless, signed crosswalk of x402 payment rails (USDC on Base) versus the AI Act Article 50 transparency obligations. The 25,491 x402 PayAI resources and 15,742 x402 CDP resources are indexed; 1,104 overlap; an indicative sample suggests between a quarter and two-fifths of declared payable endpoints never issue a 402 challenge. Every figure is signed (Ed25519), Bitcoin-anchored (OTS), and reproducible from a public artifact.

What we are NOT claiming:
  - that Stripe accepts or endorses this
  - that x402 is the only payment rail (it is one of several)
  - that any specific merchant is non-compliant

Live: https://councilof.ai/api/gspc
Discovery: https://councilof.ai/.well-known/
Verifier (offline, any browser): https://councilof.ai/gspc-verify

Best,
Nicholas Templeman
Founder, CSOAI Ltd (UK 16939677)
